What is BFSI?
Let us begin with "What is BFSI?"
In simple terms, it is the industry that helps people and businesses manage, save, borrow, invest, and protect their money.

Meet the Four BFSI Sectors
There are four major sectors of BFSI: Banking, Financial Services (NBFCs), Securities & Capital Markets, and Insurance. 
These four sectors are closely connected to our everyday lives.

BFSI in Everyday Life
Let us look at an example: In your everyday life you may have a bank account, use UPI or a debit card, take an education or home loan, invest in a mutual fund, or have health or life insurance. 
All these activities are part of BFSI industry.

Step into Financial Services
Now, let us explore Financial Services!
Financial Services are companies that provide loans, investments, payments and other financial solutions and NBFC is an important part of this sector.

Discover NBFCs
NBFC stands for Non-Banking Financial Company.
NBFCs serve individuals, small businesses, farmers, and many other customer segments.
They play an important role in making credit available to businesses, especially where traditional banking may have limited reach.
